packageRules.description: A workflow file can hold secrets or write tokens, so a bump to it needs a human approval (#6506 review-gates-15). The CLI smoke pins moved from the workflow into .github/cli-smoke/, and those CLIs run beside the smoke credentials, so they keep the same approval. Renovate applies rules in order, so this rule sits after every rule that enables automerge.

A feature or image bump must refresh devcontainer-lock.json in the same PR. Automerge would land the bump alone and leave the lock stale, so these updates stay reviewable. This rule sits last on purpose: Renovate applies rules in order, and no rule after it may re-enable automerge.
